title: feat: GIG-3802: Output A TablePlus Database Link From Ngramx Review
description: After ngramx review or ngramx worktree brings an environment up, it prints a clickable TablePlus URL for that environment's database.

test_plan.description: Review prints a TablePlus URL on the published database port
steps: From think-fire-defence, run php bin/ngramx from this branch: review gig-2501 --worktree
Confirm the output includes a TablePlus URL on 127.0.0.1 and the worktree's database port
Open that URL and confirm TablePlus connects to think_fire_defence as postgres
Run the same review in a project with no published SQL database and confirm no TablePlus line is printed

test_plan.description: A shared hosted database uses the connect session instead of the compose database
steps: Confirm the TablePlus URL uses the postmaclone connect IDE host and port
Run review with --no-host-mapping and no connect session and confirm no TablePlus line is printed
